long_biography.plain_text:
During the shipping downturn, Erck Rickmers stepped back from daily management to study comparative religion at the University of California, Santa Barbara. The distance helped him reassess a cyclical industry: his group sold large container ships, reduced debt and exited E.R. Schiffahrt, while he completed a master's degree in religious studies.

Today Rickmers directs E.R. Capital, a private investment and asset-management group spanning property, renewable energy, mid-market companies, private equity and remaining shipping interests. Through Quest Investment Partners, he is also a managing shareholder in commercial-property development and management. His interest in the humanities led him to finance research centres and later found THE NEW INSTITUTE, which closed in 2026 after a five-year programme.
